title: Daft Punk in Surreal Realm
description: A figure in a red velvet suit and Daft Punk helmet stands in a gothic hall, holding a glowing red heart in one hand while green smoke and eyeballs emanate from a bubbling cauldron on the windowsill. Outside the large arched window, a stormy purple sky looms over a fantastical landscape with a green fairy flying above a boat on a river of lava.
prompt: A figure wearing a sleek black Daft Punk helmet with glowing blue visor and a luxurious red velvet suit stands inside a dark gothic hall with dripping black ooze and crystal chandeliers, holding a small glowing red heart in his left hand while extending his right hand, green mystical smoke and floating eyeballs rising from a bubbling green cauldron on the stone windowsill, outside the large arched window is a dramatic stormy purple sky with lightning, a glowing green fairy with wings flying above a small boat on a river of lava flowing through a surreal landscape, highly detailed digital painting in dark fantasy style by Logan S.
